text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I heard her voice while I was running.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEERRRBYYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't count how many times all her<n>silly yelling
has cheered me up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But today, it terrified me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Why isn't anything working? Why<n>can't I...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Tic-ke-zo! Tic-ke-zo! Tic-ke-zo!<n>Tic-ke-zo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah! I did it, I did it, I did it! I WON!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, everyone! I did it!<n>I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on this huge win,<n>Winning Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm so, so, so happy right<n>now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I poured my heart and soul into this<n>race. Winning
the Derby has been my<n>dream for so long, and I
trained as<n>hard as I could for it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sob... I did it all for the sake of thisvictory!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: And you did fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna work even harder! I'm<n>gonna keep
giving my fans the most<n>exciting races possible!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support,<n>everyone! I hope you'll
continue to<n>cheer me on!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She's planning to become even<n>faster than that?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If she does, then I'll... I'll...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thanks, but... I wasn't good enough—I<n>lost.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She's still reeling from the loss and<n>remains silent.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
What can I say to make her feel<n>better? It reminds
me of before...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide looks just as<n>despondent as she
did after the<n>Satsuki Sho.
choice_data_list:
Do you remember what happened at the Satsuki
Sho?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her shoulders jump. It appears she<n>does, and her
current worries have<n>some connection to it.
choice_data_list: What have you been thinking about since then?
What have you been thinking about since then?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Talk about rubbing salt in the wound...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I can't stop thinking about how I keep<n>losing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've lost twice now. Once to Taishin at<n>the Satsuki
Sho, and again to Ticket at<n>the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We planned for so many scenarios<n>and tried to
anticipate so many<n>variables. But they just have
something I lack.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I don't know what to do.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Whatever that something is, if it's not<n>simply an
oversight... If it's<n>something I'm intrinsically
missing,<n>then beating them is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list:
Let's factor that "something" into the equation,
then!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: I know you can figure this out!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Where are you getting that confidence<n>from? I
don't have the foggiest idea<n>what it could be, so
how am I<n>supposed to solve for it?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is extremely smart.<n>Smart enough
to figure out most<n>things on her own.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's why she always tries to solve<n>everything
alone, even when facing<n>an insurmountable
challenge. But...
choice_data_list: You can still give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You can't be serious.
choice_data_list:
Hey, if you plug in enough variables, you'll
eventually nail it, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You really think I can find the right<n>answer by
repeatedly testing a<n>baseless calculation?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's absolutely absurd. Not only<n>does it make no
sense, it's<n>completely illogical.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Only someone utterly desperate to<n>solve an
equation would try<n>something like that.
choice_data_list: Which is why I suggested it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You know me too well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: We stay and talk in the waiting room<n>for a while.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We speak about why Biwa Hayahide<n>suddenly
feels such a gap between<n>herself and her two
rivals, and what<n>she can do about it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've identified what our priority<n>should be based on
our discussion.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Equipping me with the iron will to<n>improve. I need
you to think back for<n>a second.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch... I'm fine. I can keep going.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You saw Hayahide's race. She was<n>amazing. I
want to win harder than<n>ever, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I poured my heart and soul into this<n>race. Winning
the Derby has been my<n>dream for so long, and I
trained as<n>hard as I could for it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My hypothesis is that Ticket and<n>Taishin's
willingness to do whatever<n>it takes to win is the
source of their<n>drive and determination.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good. I have a favor to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Going forward, don't be afraid topush me to my limits. In fact, I wantyou to make me work harder.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure. I don't ever want to taste<n>defeat again,
and to ensure that I<n>don't, I need to push myself
harder!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She starts running again, this time<n>with a new
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I won't ever lose again!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, with a determination<n>bordering on
obsession...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide sets her sights on the<n>final race of
the Classic Triple Crown<n>tour—the Kikuka Sho.
